name: Loose — criteria named, judgement left to the grader
description: Each criterion is named and given a one-line intent. No evaluation criteria, no quality checks, no anchoring examples, no negative points. This is the rubric most teams actually start with, and it is the control for how much of an approach's behaviour comes from the rubric rather than the model.

criteria.description: Does the solution produce correct results?
Does the solution handle boundary and degenerate inputs?
Is the approach appropriate for the problem?
Is the code readable and well structured?
